market.findYourTool: Find the right tool for the job
market.categoryHint: Browse by use case; each collection documents its processing design, provenance and limits.
market.trustTitle: Clear scope you can check before use
market.trust1Desc: Local-capable workflows are designed to run on the device; verify the active tool disclosure and network behavior.
market.trust2Desc: No installation is required. Guests receive the free daily quota shown on the page; paid passes are optional.
market.trust3Desc: We check current features, provenance and limitations; material disclosure changes appear in the public changelog.
market.evidenceIntro: PDF, image and most developer tools are designed for browser execution; website inspection and AI-assisted experiences send service requests. Browser-side processing describes architecture, not an independent security audit.
market.evidenceBrowserDesc: Keep originals and verify output. Formats, file sizes and practical capability depend on the active page, browser and device.
market.evidenceServerDesc: Website checks are point-in-time automated observations. Traditional-culture entertainment has no established scientific basis. Neither should drive high-stakes decisions.
market.methodLink: Read the full sources and verification method
market.guidesDesc: Guides are checked against the current deployment and source code, with explicit use cases, parameter tradeoffs, quotas and non-guarantees.
market.verificationLink: See the public test method, page-uniqueness checks and current parameter snapshot
market.mergeGuideDesc: File order, page ranges, bookmarks, quality effects and browser-processing limits.
market.compressPdfGuideDesc: Compare Condense and Photon, four compression levels, DPI, image quality and text selectability.
market.imageGuideDesc: JPEG, WebP and PNG quality settings, and the boundary of genuinely lossless compression.
market.entertainmentDesc: Traditional-culture experiences are separated from productivity tools. Outputs have no established scientific basis and are not for high-stakes decisions.
market.guestQuotaDesc: The default is 3 per day, resetting in Asia/Shanghai; the live remaining count on the page controls.
market.userQuotaDesc: The default is 5 per day. Registration and sign-in involve account data described in the privacy policy.
market.pricingFactDesc: 1 day $0.99, 7 days $4.99, 30 days $9.99, and 365 days $59.99; checkout controls.
